title: Release Engineering - Meeting Notes (2026-06-09)
content:
Attendees: Miguel Hernandez (owner), Asha Patel, Olivia Chen, Samir Rao, Ella Brooks, Ben Kline (SRE sync)

Summary:
- Weekly release-engineering sync focused on this week's release train v1.42 and an emergent hotfix (RINF-2347) for a tokenization edge-case observed in production.
- Agreed on a tightened canary window and rollback triggers after the instability observed in alpha on 2026-06-07.

Agenda and notes:
1) Release train v1.42 status
   - Cut candidate: rc-v1.42.0 created 2026-06-08 18:22 UTC (CI: green barring flaky integration tests).
   - Notable features: improved KV-cache eviction heuristics, batching opt to reduce tail latency for short-seq requests.
   - Owners: Asha (runtime changes), Olivia (packaging/manifest), Samir (deploy automation).
   - Blockers: one flaky test in runtime/attention_map_test causing intermittent CI timeout (~2-3% of runs). Investigating test harness timing; Samir to file a follow-up PR to increase jitter tolerance (PR referenced: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/389).

2) Hotfix RINF-2347 (tokenization edge-case)
   - Incident: a customer reported token-splitting mismatch for high-unicode inputs leading to malformed prompts in hosted API. Repro ticket RINF-2347.
   - Triage: root cause localized to tokenizer fallback path introduced in rc-v1.42.0 branch, failing on certain Unicode normalization sequences.
   - Action: emergency branch hotfix/tokenizer-fix-2347 created; patch submitted and reviewed. Target rollout: hotfix to canary (10% traffic) 2026-06-09 22:00 UTC, full rollout 2026-06-10 02:00 UTC if no regressions.
   - Rollback plan: immediate rollback to previous tokenizer code path (tag: v1.41.3) if error rate > 0.5% in 15-minute window or any customer-facing 5xxs. SRE (Ben) to own automated rollback triggers.

3) Canary and observability changes
   - Metrics to monitor for both rc and hotfix: tokenization error-rate, request success rate, p50/p95/p99 latency for generation, token-per-request distribution, memory growth on GPUs.
   - New dashboards prepared in Console under "release/canary-2026-06-09". Ella to add alert thresholds by EOD.
   - Tracing: increase sampling rate for canary traffic to 5% to capture edge traces.

4) Change log & customer communication
   - Changelog items: list of features and bugfixes for v1.42 and the hotfix entry for tokenization. Draft changelog located: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/RELEASE/pages/12345/June+2026+Release+Plan.
   - Communications: Product comms to publish a short note for enterprise customers explaining the hotfix and the safe rollback policy. Olivia to draft customer-facing blurb by 2026-06-09 20:00 UTC.

5) CI / Release automation improvements
   - Observed: flaky runtime tests slow down cut cadence. Short-term: mark known flaky tests as flaky in CI to avoid blocking cut; long-term: root cause and rewrite harness. Samir to open follow-up ticket RINF-2350 for harness rework.
   - Release tooling: add post-deploy smoke check that runs a small suite against the canary pool (10 requests across sequence lengths) before bumping traffic to 50%. Miguel to add to release-job by tomorrow.

6) Scheduled windows and constraints
   - No formal release freeze this week, but calendar note: Dedicated customers scheduled maintenance window 2026-06-11 00:00-04:00 UTC - avoid broad rollouts during that period.

7) Postmortem items from last week
   - Action items: SRE to finalize the improved rollback playbook; CI owners to tag flaky tests and notify authors. Status: in progress.

Action items (owner / due):
- Samir: PR to increase test tolerance for attention_map_test and open RINF-2350 (CI harness rework). Due 2026-06-10.
- Ella: Add canary alert thresholds and update dashboard "release/canary-2026-06-09". Due 2026-06-09 EOD.
- Olivia: Draft customer-facing communication about hotfix and changelog entry. Due 2026-06-09 20:00 UTC.
- Asha: Monitor runtime memory growth during canary and validate KV-cache eviction metrics. Report by 2026-06-10 04:00 UTC.
- Ben (SRE): Configure automated rollback triggers for hotfix (error-rate and 5xx detection). Test rollback trigger in staging. Due 2026-06-09 23:00 UTC.
- Miguel: Add post-deploy smoke check to release job and validate with dry-run. Due 2026-06-10.

Open questions / decision needed:
- How aggressive to be with promoting the hotfix to full fleet if minor increase in p95 latency is observed? (Tentative decision: accept up to 5% p95 increase if tokenization error-rate drops to <0.05% and no 5xxs. Final call by SRE + release lead during canary.)
- Should we backport the tokenizer fix to earlier maintenance branches for Dedicated customers? Product and support to advise on customer impact.

Notes & references:
- Incident ticket: RINF-2347 (tokenizer mismatch)
- Release candidate: rc-v1.42.0
- Hotfix branch: hotfix/tokenizer-fix-2347
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-release/pull/412, https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/389

Next meeting: 2026-06-16 09:30 PT (weekly sync).

-- Miguel Hernandez
Release Engineering
